verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs show first-party SLO definition with alerting when the SLO budget is threatened. They also show error-budget tracking through Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs, and SLO burn alerts routable to Slack, PagerDuty, or webhooks, with SLOs manageable via the API. missing for 10: detailed documentation of burn-rate alert configuration (thresholds/windows, exhaustion-time vs. rate settings), independent or hands-on corroboration of SLO/burn-alert behavior.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts

citations.quote: Use Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to define an agreement regarding delivery of a given service and be alerted when your SLO budget is threatened.
Honeycomb will track SLO values past your retention period, but will display these for only the Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs.
Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.
Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
